title: SpaceX Stock (SPCX) Falls 5.7% on Reports of a Tesla Merger (Nov 24)
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) fell 5.65% to $125.81 on Nov 24 after an FT report on Tesla merger teams and an AI stock pullback. Here is what moved SPCX.
body_markdown:
## Why SpaceX Stock Fell


According to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/tesla-and-spacex-assemble-deal-teams-for-a-merger-that-could-give-musk-majority-control-144555932.html) , citing the Financial Times, five directors are overseeing the two special committees weighing a[potential $3.5 trillion merger](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/tesla-tsla-stock-news-november-24-2026/) : Roelof Botha and Randy Glein from SpaceX, and Robyn Denholm, Kathleen Wilson-Thompson and Jack Hartung from Tesla. Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs are advising SpaceX and Evercore is advising Tesla on a proposed all-stock deal, though the exchange ratio has yet to be agreed and a deal could be reached before year-end, the report said.


As reported by[The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/24/here-s-why-spacex-stock-slumped-today-and-why-it-could-come-under-more-pressure-as-tesla-merger-talks-continue/) , SpaceX was down 5.8% at midday, and the outlet called the fall "classic pre-deal positioning behavior." In an all-stock deal, Tesla shares would convert into new SpaceX shares at a fixed ratio, and the Motley Fool said investors were positioning on the bet that SpaceX, as the acquirer, would pay Tesla holders a hefty premium or a good exchange ratio.


Pressure also came from the wider AI trade. Per[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/spacex-falls-4-coreweave-down-185758049.html) , writing during the session, AI stocks gave back part of[Monday's Nvidia rally](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-24-2026/) after Hewlett Packard Enterprise CEO Antonio Neri said on the company's fourth-quarter call on Monday evening that its financing arm "has not provided financing to neocloud or high-risk customers." TIKR said that funding worry about neoclouds, companies that rent out AI computing power, hit SpaceX too because of its own compute-rental business.


## SPCX Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Starlink's Connectivity segment earned $2.37 billion of SpaceX's $2.79 billion in third-quarter operating income, per TIKR, which cited it as a cushion against the AI sell-off.
- The Super Intelligence segment, which rents computing power to AI companies, brought in $7.56 billion of SpaceX's $14.6 billion third-quarter revenue, according to TIKR.


### Risks


- Spending is climbing fast: third-quarter capital spending was $19.6 billion, nearly triple a year earlier, and management expects $35 billion to $40 billion in the fourth quarter, per TIKR.
- One customer supplied 34.5% of third-quarter revenue, according to TIKR, which concentrates revenue in a single relationship.
- Merger terms remain open, and Yahoo Finance said Musk, who controls about 84% of SpaceX's voting power, could end up with majority voting control of a combined company depending on the terms.
